subject.title: [Feature]: Merge the composer voice level meter into the stop-voice control and disambiguate the two stop buttons

question: Should Control UI Talk adopt the merged-meter voice-stop control now, keep the current separate activity pill with smaller visual tweaks, or defer this to a broader composer redesign?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the permanent control treatment is a product and UX choice on a protected maintainer-labeled issue.

options.title: Adopt merged-meter voice stop
options.body: Use the existing microphone activity element inside the active voice-stop control, remove the floating active pill, and restyle run abort as the only danger stop square.

options.title: Clarify without merging
options.body: Keep the separate activity pill but differentiate the two stop controls with icon, color, or layout changes if maintainers prefer the current status structure.

options.title: Defer to composer redesign
options.body: Leave the current behavior until a broader composer-control pass decides the Talk and run-control hierarchy together.

recommendation.title: Adopt merged-meter voice stop
recommendation.body: Use the existing microphone activity element inside the active voice-stop control, remove the floating active pill, and restyle run abort as the only danger stop square.
